qualifier: with their storage diseases and glucokinase control
name: Glycogen synthesis and breakdown and glycogen storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, branching, glycogenolysis, glycophagy, glucokinase regulation and the GYS/GBE1/GAA/GYG1/Lafora storage disorders, whereas confusables centre on glucose-6-phosphatase/G6P transport, glycolysis or glucagon-PKA signalling.

qualifier: recombination, synapsis and chromosome segregation
name: Meiotic recombination, synapsis and chromosome segregation
rationale: All members concern meiotic divisions (DSB formation, strand invasion, chiasmata, synaptonemal complex, meiotic cohesion, spindle and checkpoint control), distinguishing them from mitotic spindle/cohesion and germline epigenetic/MZT confusables.

qualifier: common gamma-chain and IL-3/IL-5 receptors
name: Common gamma-chain and IL-3/IL-5 cytokine STAT5 signalling
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15, IL-21, IL-3 and IL-5 signalling with STAT5 output and T/NK cell effects, unlike confusables built on FLT3-STAT5, IL-10/IL-12 family, interferon or Th2/mast-cell cytokines.

qualifier: tachykinin receptor control in gut and urogenital tract
name: Tachykinin-regulated visceral smooth muscle of gut and urogenital tract
rationale: Members cover gastrointestinal, uterine and urinary smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, gastric function, micturition, erection and parturition plus tachykinin receptor signalling, whereas confusables carry serotonin, muscarinic, histamine or GnRH receptor signalling.

core: Forebrain axon tract and neuronal migration development
qualifier: commissures and radial glia-guided migration
name: Forebrain axon tract morphogenesis and radial glia-guided neuron migration
rationale: Members are corpus callosum, anterior commissure and corticospinal tract morphogenesis plus radial glial differentiation, neuroblast division and radial-glia-guided migration, unlike confusables on cerebellum/L1 or cortical layering and tangential interneuron migration.

core: p53-dependent apoptosis and cell cycle arrest
qualifier: and their evasion via TP53, p14ARF and p16INK4A defects
name: p53-dependent apoptosis and arrest and their evasion in cancer
rationale: Members are TP53 transcriptional control of caspases, PUMA/NOXA, death receptors and p21/G1 arrest plus cancer-associated TP53, ARF and INK4A defects, distinguishing them from senescence/SASP confusables and from downstream BCL-2/apoptosome machinery.

qualifier: MHC class II peptide
name: MHC class II peptide antigen processing and presentation
rationale: Members centre on exogenous peptide loading and presentation on MHC class II (including germinal centre B cells), distinguishing them from MHC class I cross-presentation, CD1 lipid presentation and DC surface signature confusables.

qualifier: HNF4-driven brush-border programme of gut, liver and kidney
name: HNF4-driven absorptive brush-border epithelium of gut, liver and kidney
rationale: Nearly all members are HNF4A/HNF4G-centred modules of absorptive brush-border epithelium in intestine, liver and kidney tubule (the lone leukocyte migration term is an outlier), whereas confusables carry KLF5/EPCAM GI barrier, crypt stem and epithelial development terms.

core: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
qualifier: with malate-aspartate shuttle and carboxylate anion transport
name: Glutamate, aspartate and ammonium metabolism with carboxylate anion transport
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine/aspartate metabolism, ammonium handling, the malate-aspartate shuttle and SLC13/SLC17/SLC25 di- and tricarboxylate transport, unlike TCA/gluconeogenesis, urea cycle, cationic amino acid or carnitine transport confusables.

qualifier: COPII/COPI ER-Golgi transport and Golgi organization
name: ER-Golgi COPII/COPI vesicle traffic and Golgi organization
rationale: Members are COPII export, COPI retrograde and intra-Golgi transport, Golgi tethering/fusion and Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly, distinguishing them from post-Golgi endosome/lysosome sorting and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation confusables.

qualifier: cullin neddylation and COP9 signalosome deneddylation
name: Cullin neddylation and COP9 signalosome deneddylation
rationale: Members are neddylation, its positive regulation, deneddylation and CSN assembly plus CUL1-mediated NRF2 degradation, whereas confusables concern ubiquitin chain types, deubiquitinases, E1/E2 and PD-L1 degradation.

qualifier: androgen and estrogen (aromatase)
name: Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism
rationale: All members concern androgen and estrogen synthesis or androgen catabolism, including aromatase excess, distinguishing them from glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid synthesis and adrenal CYP defect confusables.

qualifier: vesicle endocytosis, recycling, clustering and active zone structure
name: Presynaptic vesicle recycling and active zone organization
rationale: Members are synaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling and clustering, clathrin uncoating and presynaptic active zone/cytoskeleton maintenance, unlike postsynaptic receptor trafficking, transmitter secretion or clathrin coat assembly confusables.

qualifier: cerebellar cortex layering and motor coordination
name: Regional brain development centred on cerebellar cortex layering
rationale: Members span cerebellar Purkinje/granular layer formation, Bergmann glia and motor learning together with thalamus, striatum, substantia nigra and brainstem development, whereas confusables add locomotor behaviour or pons/hindbrain maturation.

core: Integrin adhesion and actin cytoskeletal remodelling
qualifier: Rho-ROCK/PAK stress fibres in cell spreading
name: Integrin adhesion and Rho-ROCK/PAK stress-fibre remodelling
rationale: Members are integrin/syndecan adhesion, ROCK and PAK activation, stress fibre assembly, cell spreading and migration and platelet activation, distinguishing them from fibronectin matrix, MET-PTK2 and PINCH-ILK-parvin confusables.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and ketone body metabolism
name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are the chain-shortening steps of mitochondrial beta-oxidation, carnitine synthesis/transport/shuttle and ketone body synthesis and use, unlike confusables on branched-chain amino acid and cofactor disorders or alpha-oxidation.

qualifier: regulation of calcium-triggered vesicle priming and fusion
name: Regulation of calcium-triggered synaptic vesicle exocytosis and priming
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle priming, fusion and calcium-dependent exocytosis, spontaneous release and short-term potentiation, whereas confusables add transmitter-specific release cycles, docking/SNARE assembly, calcium channels or vesicle recycling.

qualifier: Notch O-glycosylation
name: Somite segmentation and Notch O-fucosylation and glucosylation
rationale: Members are somite specification, axis elongation and segmentation together with Notch processing and O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation (LFNG, B3GALTL), distinguishing them from Hox, limb, neural plate and Nodal confusables.

qualifier: PGC migration, meiotic entry and sperm mitochondrial sheath
name: Germ cell migration, meiotic entry and sperm mitochondrial sheath
rationale: Members cover primordial germ cell migration, germ cell proliferation and death, Sertoli barrier, meiosis activation and sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly, unlike confusables on Leydig/Sertoli development, oocyte maturation or sperm motility.

qualifier: mesenchymal progenitor and tendon, with matrix synthesis
name: Osteoblast, tendon and mesenchymal progenitor proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, trabecular bone, tendon and collagen/proteoglycan synthesis, distinguishing them from RUNX2, ossification, mineralization and BMP confusables.

qualifier: protein import, fission and pexophagy
name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and pexophagy
rationale: Members are peroxisomal matrix and membrane protein import, fission and pexophagy, whereas confusables concern peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and lipid synthesis.

qualifier: NOD1/2 and TLR2/4/5 recognition of cell-wall ligands
name: NOD1/2 and TLR2/4/5 sensing of bacterial cell-wall ligands
rationale: Members cover NOD1/2, peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide, LPS, lipoteichoic acid and lipopeptide responses and MyD88/IRAK4 deficiency in TLR2/4/5 signalling, unlike confusables on endogenous TLR ligands, IPAF inflammasome or TAK1/ALPK1 kinases.

qualifier: myelin formation and maintenance with axon caliber control
name: Myelin formation and maintenance with axon caliber control
rationale: Members are CNS and PNS myelin formation and maintenance, Schwann cell myelination initiation, oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation, axon diameter and neurofilament organization, whereas confusables carry gliosis, glial proliferation or nodal/paranodal assembly.

qualifier: filament capping, severing and turnover
name: Actin filament capping, severing and turnover at the leading edge
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, barbed-end capping, severing and depolymerization in lamellipodia, ruffles and pseudopodia, distinguishing them from WASP/WAVE Arp2/3 activation, crosslinking and macropinocytosis confusables.

qualifier: cornification and desmosome-hemidesmosome anchoring
name: Epidermal cornification and desmosome-hemidesmosome anchoring
rationale: Members are cornified envelope assembly, keratinocyte development, skin barrier, desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly and anchoring fibril formation, unlike confusables on cardiac adhesion, laminin/integrin or basement membrane organization.
